definition.title: Where ARIES thinks
definition.description: 'local' enables the local model. Separate cloud_enabled policy controls explicit foreground escalation; background workers remain local. 'none' switches language models off entirely; ARIES keeps every deterministic capability.

definition.title: The local model
definition.description: Which model the configured local runtime should use. It must exist — ARIES will not download several gigabytes without being asked.

definition.title: Gateway Enabled
definition.description: Use the persistent local gateway; direct local fallback on gateway outage only.

definition.title: Where the local model answers
definition.description: Local runtime address. Only literal loopback URLs are accepted, preventing access from the network.

definition.title: Cloud Enabled
definition.description: Explicit opt-in to send foreground tasks/context to configured cloud endpoint.

definition.title: Cloud Local Fallback
definition.description: If cloud is unavailable, use local inference and record degradation.

definition.title: Router Enabled
definition.description: Route workspace goals through rules, local decisions and explicit cloud policy.

definition.title: Temperature
definition.description: How much the model gambles on less likely words. 0 is repeatable and literal; around 0.7 is conversational; above 1.2 it invents. Structured extraction and routing decisions are more reliable low.

definition.title: Top-p (nucleus)
definition.description: Keeps only the most likely words whose probabilities add up to this fraction. 1.0 considers everything; 0.5 keeps the model on the obvious path. Temperature is the dial to try first — this one mostly matters above temperature 1.

definition.title: Context window
definition.description: How much conversation and document text the local model may hold at once. Larger remembers more but costs video memory and reloads the model; the local runtime, not ARIES, decides what it can fit.

definition.title: Maximum answer length
definition.description: Longest answer the local model may produce in one turn. Lower it for terse replies and faster responses; a task that needs more than it gets fails loudly rather than returning a truncated answer.

definition.title: Notice what matters
definition.description: Let ARIES decide for itself which of the things you say are worth remembering, and write them down without being asked. What you said is stored verbatim and separately from what ARIES concluded from it.

ARIES_CAP_TOPK.governs: the planner is sent the most relevant capabilities, not all of them

ARIES_COMPLETION_PROGRESS_GUARD.governs: stop after two rejected completion proposals without an intervening action; preserve one correction opportunity

ARIES_COMPLETION_READ_PARAPHRASE.governs: the completion contract also recognises read, listing and existence goals said in natural words (exactly one path, nothing else asked) and strips sentence punctuation from paths; done still needs re-checked verified evidence. Off compiles only the anchored sentences, as in ARIES-FINAL-20261006

ARIES_CONTEXT_ENGINE.governs: select memory, recent task history and permitted cached news with provenance, expiry and explicit missing-source coverage

ARIES_CONTRACT_FINISH.governs: propose completion without another model call when every ordered goal condition has verified evidence; fresh independent recheck still required

ARIES_GOAL_TEAMS.governs: decompose eligible goals into scoped temporary read-only runtime agents in the existing queue

ARIES_MK_FROZEN.governs: Macedonian is frozen: it keeps working and keeps being tested, and nothing new is built on it

ARIES_PLANNER_CLARIFY.governs: the planner may stop and ask which target is meant when its own verified observations show several that fit the goal; every choice must name something observed. Off removes the option from the grammar and the prompt

ARIES_PLAN_MEMORY.governs: relevant remembered facts are injected into planning

ARIES_ROUTER_ABSTAIN.governs: the router may answer ASK or OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than choosing the nearest action; off restores the pre-2026-10-03 instruction to pick the nearest one regardless

ARIES_STATE_SNAPSHOT.governs: the planner is given the current desktop state before it plans

ARIES_TERMINAL_READ_FAILURE.governs: stop repeated model planning after an actual nonretryable missing-file error for the exact single requested read

ARIES_TILE_HIDPI.governs: desktop.tile reads the monitor's scale factor from Mutter and expects the device-pixel-aligned rectangle, so a correct tile on a fractionally scaled display is not reported unverified

ARIES_TRACE_FEWSHOT.governs: similar past successful plans are offered to the planner

ARIES_TYPE_STRICT.governs: input.type_text refuses any case that would silently lose characters — a NUL, a filtered control character, a line break into a single-line control, a rejected or partially landed write — instead of returning a success carrying landed=false

ARIES_VERIFY_FEEDBACK.governs: the planner is told whether each past step's effect was INDEPENDENTLY OBSERVED, not merely whether the tool returned. Off leaves the loop, the retry policy and the step history untouched and removes only that — the one variable in the state-verification-feedback experiment

registry.name: file.read
registry.description: Read a regular UTF-8 text file up to 100 KB

registry.name: file.write
registry.description: Create a NEW nonempty text file; never overwrite. Parent must exist.

registry.name: file.list
registry.description: List at most 200 allowed directory entries

registry.name: file.search
registry.description: Search filenames under a directory, optionally within an ISO modification-time range

registry.name: file.exists
registry.description: Check existence only when asked about existence. For read goals use file.read directly, which reports missing-path errors.

registry.name: browser.open
registry.description: Open a public URL in a task-owned browser and observe navigation

registry.name: browser.read
registry.description: Read a task-owned browser session using its observed session ID

registry.name: browser.search
registry.description: Open public web or YouTube search for a literal query

registry.name: desktop.launch
registry.description: Open an installed application by name; verify visible focused window

registry.name: desktop.focus
registry.description: Focus an already observed installed app; never launch a replacement

registry.name: system.status
registry.description: Observe current CPU, memory and disk probes

registry.name: system.storage
registry.description: Measure filesystem usage; highest is computed from measured percentages

registry.name: system.processes
registry.description: Observe bounded process names and IDs; no command lines

registry.name: task.inspect
registry.description: Inspect a persisted task by ID

registry.name: notification.send
registry.description: Create a policy-controlled notification record; approval required

registry.name: desktop.windows
registry.description: Observe authoritative GNOME windows; unavailable is an error

registry.name: desktop.observe
registry.description: Observe authoritative GNOME windows; unavailable is an error

registry.name: desktop.close
registry.description: Operate on an exact observed window ID and application identity

registry.description: Operate on an exact observed window ID and application identity

registry.description: Operate on an exact observed window ID and application identity

registry.description: Operate on an exact observed window ID and application identity

registry.description: Operate on an exact observed window ID and application identity

registry.name: desktop.minimize

registry.name: desktop.tile
registry.description: Operate on an exact observed window ID and application identity. The rectangle is computed by the shell from the monitor work area and verified against the monitor scale factor, so a tile on a fractionally scaled display is not reported unconfirmed (ARIES_TILE_HIDPI)

registry.name: browser.tabs

registry.name: browser.observe

registry.name: browser.elements
registry.description: Task-owned public browser elements; observe again after action. No credentials or POST.

registry.name: browser.navigate
registry.description: Task-owned public browser navigate; observe again after action. No credentials or POST.

registry.name: browser.click
registry.description: Task-owned public browser click; observe again after action. No credentials or POST.

registry.name: browser.type
registry.description: Task-owned public browser type; observe again after action. No credentials or POST.

registry.name: browser.scroll
registry.description: Task-owned public browser scroll; observe again after action. No credentials or POST.

registry.name: browser.back
registry.description: Task-owned public browser back; observe again after action. No credentials or POST.

registry.name: browser.forward
registry.description: Task-owned public browser forward; observe again after action. No credentials or POST.

registry.name: browser.wait
registry.description: Task-owned public browser wait; observe again after action. No credentials or POST.

registry.name: browser.download
registry.description: Download an observed public link into a NEW reviewed local path; pinned GET, 20 MB maximum

registry.name: file.metadata
registry.description: Inspect regular file size, timestamp and SHA-256 up to 20 MB

registry.name: file.copy
registry.description: Copy a reviewed source hash to a NEW destination; no overwrite

registry.name: file.semantic_search
registry.description: Bounded local filename/PDF/text relevance with metadata filters and explanations

registry.name: file.edit
registry.description: Replace exactly one text fragment after review of source SHA-256; advisory writer lock

registry.name: file.move
registry.description: Reviewed same-filesystem atomic move to a NEW path; existing destinations refused

registry.name: file.rename
registry.description: Reviewed same-filesystem atomic move to a NEW path; existing destinations refused

registry.name: network.status
registry.description: Observe connectivity: link, addresses, gateway, DNS, and separately whether the internet is actually reachable

registry.name: network.wifi_list
registry.description: List visible wifi networks with signal strength and which are already saved; no rescan is forced

registry.name: network.wifi_connect
registry.description: Bring up an ALREADY-SAVED connection by name; ARIES never accepts a wifi password

registry.name: display.brightness
registry.description: Read the screen brightness; reports every mechanism it probed and why none is available when this machine has no brightness control

registry.name: display.set_brightness
registry.description: Set the screen brightness to a percentage and re-read it; refuses with evidence when the hardware exposes no backlight

registry.name: screen.capture
registry.description: See the screen: capture the whole screen, or the area one observed window ID occupies, to an ARIES-owned PNG. A blanked screen or a uniform frame is an error, never a result.

registry.name: screen.screenshot
registry.description: See the screen: capture the whole screen, or the area one observed window ID occupies, to an ARIES-owned PNG. A blanked screen or a uniform frame is an error, never a result.

registry.name: screen.read
registry.description: Read what is on the screen: capture it and recover its text with local OCR in Macedonian and English. Use this to answer questions about what is displayed; refuses with instructions if OCR data is missing.

registry.name: system.services
registry.description: List systemd units with their real ActiveState/SubState and activation time, from the user and system managers. Read-only; a manager that cannot answer is named, not hidden.

registry.name: system.service
registry.description: Inspect ONE systemd unit by name. A name systemd does not know is an error, never an inactive unit.

registry.name: system.service_control
registry.description: Start, stop or restart ONE allowlisted user unit. System units are refused: they need an interactive administrator password. Verified by re-reading the unit; a new InvocationID is the proof, not an accepted job.

registry.name: system.disk
registry.description: Measure filesystem usage with statvfs and the largest directories under your home folder. Bounded by depth, entry count and time; a truncated walk says so.

registry.name: system.packages
registry.description: Check whether a package is installed and at what version, through dpkg and snap. Never installs anything.

registry.name: input.clipboard_read
registry.description: Read the current clipboard as text, bounded to 100 KB. Use it only when the user asks what is on the clipboard: it returns whatever they last copied, which may be a password, so never call it for context.

registry.name: input.clipboard_write
registry.description: Replace the clipboard with text and verify it by reading it back from a fresh session. The previous clipboard is destroyed and cannot be restored, so approval is required.

registry.name: input.editable_targets
registry.description: List one running application's editable text controls with the node identity input.type_text needs. Password fields are never listed. Call this first; a node path alone is not a target.

registry.name: input.type_text
registry.description: Insert text into ONE control previously reported by input.editable_targets, re-verifying its identity first. Refused unless it is still editable, enabled, focused, in the active window, free of a selection and not a password field. Terminals do not support this and are refused, not approximated. Any text that would arrive incomplete is refused with the reason and the observed character counts, never reported as a success (ARIES_TYPE_STRICT).

limitations: Small synthetic authored fixture,24 distinct goals, no human annotator or hidden test set.
Three temperature-zero repetitions measure reproducibility rather than sampling robustness.
Frozen full-catalogue and no-contract settings are a declared controlled configuration, not default interactive top-k behavior.
Exact next-action capability and arguments are measured, not actual execution, policy approval, verifier quality, multi-step completion or voice.
Browser histories and writable-directory preconditions are synthetic; no real browser or file outcome is proven.
The production system prompt already contains explicit guidance for file reads, writes, storage and browser titles; performance on these cases cannot establish general planning intelligence.
